# Capstone Part 3: Deployment and Reporting

## Overview
A model that only lives in your notebook can't demonstrate impact, so Part 3 turns your capstone into a shareable product and a compelling story, the parts that most impress employers and stakeholders. First, you package your trained model and build an interface: a Streamlit app where users enter inputs and get predictions, or an interactive dashboard that presents your analysis. You then deploy it to the cloud (for example, Streamlit Community Cloud) so it has a public URL anyone can visit, proving you can ship end-to-end. Equally important is communication: you write a professional project report that walks a reader through the business problem, your approach, key findings, model performance, limitations, and recommendations, structured as a narrative rather than a code dump. Finally, you prepare a concise presentation of your data story tailored to a non-technical audience, leading with the insight and recommendation. This combination, a live deployed app, a clear written report, and a crisp presentation, is exactly what turns a learning project into a portfolio centerpiece that showcases the full range of data science skills to potential employers.

## Deep Dive
This module covers: Packaging the model for deployment; Building a Streamlit app or dashboard; Deploying to the cloud; Writing a professional project report; Presenting a data story. Mastering these ideas is essential because they appear repeatedly in production AI systems.

### What You Will Learn
- The core theory behind today's topic.
- How to apply it using Python, NumPy, Pandas, or the relevant framework.
- How to evaluate results and avoid common mistakes.
- Where to find authoritative references when you need deeper detail.

### Real-World Context
In industry, these skills are used daily: data scientists clean messy survey data, AI engineers deploy models to REST APIs, and automation engineers orchestrate pipelines. Today's practical task simulates one of these real-world scenarios.

## Hands-On Practice
Practical Task: Deploy your capstone model as a Streamlit app with a public URL, and draft a structured project report covering problem, data, methods, results, and recommendations.
Mini Project: Complete your capstone: a deployed, publicly accessible app plus a polished README/report and a short slide deck telling the data story, all committed to a professional GitHub repository.
Assignment: Write the executive summary of your capstone report: one page that states the problem, the key finding, and the recommendation for a non-technical decision-maker.

Complete all three sections. Each completed section earns points toward your CalibiAI Score. If you are unsure about any part, use the AI assessment popup to submit your work and receive dynamic feedback from DeepSeek.

## Common Mistakes to Avoid
Many beginners rush into coding before fully understanding the data. Others skip validation steps and overestimate model performance. This module helps you build the discipline of checking assumptions first, then applying algorithms systematically.

## Career Impact
The skills covered today are frequently tested in technical interviews and required in entry-level AI engineering roles. Building a portfolio that demonstrates mastery of these concepts will significantly improve your job prospects.

## Key Takeaways
1. Theory guides practice — understand before coding.
2. Clean data and clear metrics are more valuable than complex models.
3. Document your steps for reproducibility.
4. Communication matters: explain results to non-technical stakeholders.

## Next Steps After Today
- Complete the practical task and submit it for AI review.
- Read any research papers linked for deeper theory.
- Prepare questions for tomorrow's module.

## Resources
- Use the linked videos and documentation as reference material.
- Read the research papers for theoretical depth.
- Check the GitHub repositories for working code examples.

## Assessment
After finishing the work, open the AI Assessment popup to submit your practical results. DeepSeek will evaluate your submission, calculate a dynamic score based on correctness and depth, and add the points to your CalibiAI profile.
